title: stateTests
responsibility: Attributes authored committed test files to a unit state using registered scenarios and existing dependency attribution, excluding skipped and fixture-only mentions.

inputs.name: stateTests.context
inputs.description: Loaded registry, indexed source, readable tree, declarations and per-invocation attribution caches.

inputs.name: stateTests.unit
inputs.description: Stored unit identity, source ownership and authored contract selected for this review.

inputs.name: stateTests.state
inputs.description: Exact state or catalog slot to attribute; comparisons remain scoped to the selected entity.

outputs.name: stateTests
outputs.description: Existing authored test files attributable to this unit and state, with declared viewport IDs when a scenario supplies them.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: Propagates Git, filesystem, source-reader and evidence-validation failures from the invoked operation.
